title: Thorne_15: code and results for "How will we know when 1.5°C of global warming has been reached?"
description: Code, intermediate results and figure scripts for evaluating 71 methods for estimating current long-term global warming against the HadCRUT5.1 record (1850–2025, 1850–1900 baseline), MPI-ESM1.2-LR and NorESM1-M future ensembles, and the PIVW/CSCM multi-method combinations. Includes the historical-ensemble (heads/tails) analysis, the ocean heat content ensemble, the leave-one-out combination outputs (Supplement Table S4), and the source data for the climate-state dashboard. Third-party method code included as submodules or copies retains its original licence.
